cities.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET. The author has JUST APPROVED this magnificent WoodLand forest-city ecosystem and the explicit TWO STAG ANTLERS GROWING FROM ONE COMMON TREE TRUNK. KEEP that beautiful landmark geometry and the whole scene. Make ONLY TWO requested additions: the MAIN BUILDING clearly in the MIDDLE, and living FOLIAGE on the great antler-tree. Preserve the 16:9 framing, painterly Kalistar identity, gold/green/ivory/turquoise palette, cascades, bridges, terraces, light and atmosphere. No text, frame, logo or watermark.
1. MAIN BUILDING AT THE CENTER: In the central shared tree-trunk / fork area, place the city's clearly identifiable principal sanctuary, gracefully integrated into the trunk's inhabited terrace. It should sit at the HEART OF THE PAIR OF ANTLERS, visually centered beneath their open crown, with the shared trunk rising behind and supporting it. Enlarge/consolidate only the small existing ivory structures at this central fork into ONE beautiful coherent main building: organic Cerelf living-wood/ivory architecture, an elegant pointed central arch/nave, slender branching ribs, restrained turquoise crystal glazing, gently curving steps and side galleries grounded on the existing rock/root terrace. It is a magnificent fairy sanctuary, not a huge bulky Gothic castle pasted on the trunk. Keep its roof/spire BELOW the major antler beams so the two horns remain unmistakable. Main building clearly more important than neighboring dwellings but modest relative to the enormous tree. Existing central waterfall routes and connecting walkways remain physically coherent, do not dam or cover the whole cascade. No additional new towers elsewhere, no rigid symmetrical wall of chapels.
2. FOLIAGE: The author wants these great horn-shaped tree limbs to be LIVING LEAFY TREES, not bare dead wood. Add beautiful NATURAL GREEN FOLIAGE in irregular connected leafy sprays and small canopy clusters along BOTH main antler beams and their tine bases/outer branches. Lush sunlit emerald/moss leaves, subtle warm gold edge light and a little ivy, matching the surrounding forest. Enough foliage to unmistakably soften and enliven both antlers, not just two tiny sprigs at the base. But leave the characteristic woody curves, gaps and LONG TAPERING ANTLER POINTS visible against the sky. Do not hide the antler silhouette under one solid round tree canopy. The leaves grow naturally from small twigs attached to the wood, no floating bushes, hedge balls, floral orbs or cloth drapes. Preserve exactly TWO main antlers from the ONE common trunk, no ordinary separate giant trees, no additional horn or deer head. Avoid covering the central sanctuary with foliage.
Everything else stays as close as possible to this AUTHOR-LOVED IMAGE: cascades and turquoise stream, connected forest banks, flower gardens, inhabited bridges, smaller elegant dwellings and foreground path. No background redesign, camera change, extra filler, new fauna or photoreal/CGI shift. A targeted fairy-building-and-leaf pass on the same approved scene.
